bug: Port B's registered read output is held during a same-address dual-enable access when port A has any byte enabled.
trigger: On the output-update edge, en_a_reg and en_b_reg are both high, the registered addresses match, and be_a_reg is nonzero. The stale output is observable if data_out_b differs from the current RAM word at that address.
effect: data_out_b does not update to the addressed RAM word for that access, even though the original design updates it every clock.

edits.new:
if (en_a_reg && en_b_reg && (addr_a_reg == addr_b_reg) && (|be_a_reg)) begin
    end else begin
      data_out_b <= ram[addr_b_reg];
    end
